name: HSL Trains
description: Finnish passenger train station boards · Source: Fintraffic / Digitraffic, CC BY 4.0

settings.label: Polling interval
settings.help: Applies per enabled location. Serial requests are staggered; API caching and slow requests can delay events.

settings.label: Locations
settings.help: Named Finnish station boards. Add separate route or line filters at the same station. Source: Fintraffic / Digitraffic (CC BY 4.0).

fields.label: Station
fields.help: Choose or type a station name/code. Kerava: KE; Pasila: PSL; Helsinki: HKI. Bundled passenger station catalogue; new codes can be typed.

fields.label: Route station
fields.help: Optional: departures must stop here later; arrivals must have stopped here earlier. Kerava → Pasila: Station KE, Departures, Route station PSL. Direct trains only.

fields.label: Train line
fields.help: Optional single line, for example K, R, I, P or Z. Blank includes all matching lines.

fields.label: Advance notice (minutes)
fields.help: Upcoming events use the estimate, or scheduled time when no estimate exists. Zero fires only when a poll observes that time; use confirmed events for reported movements.

actions.name: Refresh trains
actions.description: Fetch one enabled station board; existing movement claims prevent repeated events.

events.name: Train arriving
events.description: Upcoming arrival within the configured advance notice.

events.name: Train departing
events.description: Upcoming departure within the configured advance notice.

events.name: Train arriving or departing
events.description: Either upcoming movement within the configured advance notice.

events.name: Train arrived
events.description: A recent arrival confirmed by the provider actualTime.

events.name: Train departed
events.description: A recent departure confirmed by the provider actualTime.

events.name: Train arrived or departed
events.description: Either recent movement confirmed by the provider actualTime.
